changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23 (moderate confidence). The Legislation Committee gave a Favorable Report on 2026-08-04 and the item (LM-2026-0285) was on the full Board of Alders' September 8, 2026 agenda. Yale Daily News reported (headline and lede snippet) that the Board voted unanimously that Tuesday to adopt the 12-month data center moratorium. This could not be independently corroborated: the Yale Daily News article itself returned a bot-detection (Kasada) challenge on both a direct and a browser-mode fetch, so only the search-engine snippet could be read; New Haven Independent, which had covered every earlier stage of this item in detail, published no follow-up story on the Sept. 8 vote; and the official September 8, 2026 Board of Alders meeting agenda (fetched directly from newhaven-ct.legistar.com) groups LM-2026-0285 together with several unrelated items under a 'Legislation. Leave to withdraw' heading, which -- taken literally -- would mean the Legislation Committee's report on this batch recommended withdrawal rather than passage. This agenda-formatting ambiguity is inconsistent with the item's own recorded 8/4/2026 'Favorable Report' status and could reflect a template/carryover artifact in how the city's agenda software groups items, rather than an actual disposition of LM-2026-0285 specifically. Because no direct, unambiguous confirmation of the final vote result could be obtained, this decision is recorded with moderate rather than high confidence.
